tools.name: add_to_cart
tools.description: Add a product to the cart. For products with options (variants), pass every option as {"OptionName": "Value"} - get_product lists the allowed values. Same product with identical options increments quantity.

options.description: Variant choices, e.g. {"Size": "M", "Color": "Red"}. Required when the product has options.

tools.name: fill_checkout_form
tools.description: Fill the checkout form on the cart page with details collected from the user, so the human only reviews and submits. Maps conversation data to the right fields: full_name is ONE field (combine first and last name), address is a single free-text delivery address. Never submits - the human completes any security check and presses the order button. Only works on the cart/checkout page (call proceed_to_checkout first; after the page loads, call this).

full_name.description: Buyer full name as one string, e.g. "Jane Smith" (combine first and last name).

email.description: Buyer email address - order confirmations go here.

phone.description: Phone number, if the user provided one.

address.description: Full delivery address as one free-text block (street, city, postal code, country as applicable).

custom.description: Values for the store extra checkout fields, keyed by the field label exactly as shown, e.g. {"Gift message": "Happy birthday"}.

payment_method.description: One of the payment options visible on the page: "card", "paypal", "crypto", "cod" (cash on delivery / pickup) or "link" (pay online).

tools.name: get_cart
tools.description: Get the current shopping cart: line items, quantities, selected options, subtotal and the checkout URL.

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: Get full details for one product by its id (from search_products), including price, availability, description, images and buyable options (variants).

tools.name: get_store_info
tools.description: Get information about this store: name, description, currency, product count and the checkout URL.

tools.name: proceed_to_checkout
tools.description: Navigate the shopper’s current browser session to the checkout page. This action does NOT place an order or submit payment - the human shopper must review the cart and complete checkout manually. Call after the cart is ready.

tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Search this store's product catalog. Returns matching products with id, price, availability and buyable options (variants). Use the returned id with add_to_cart.

query.description: Free-text search over name, description, brand and category. Omit to browse by filters alone.

min_price.description: Only products priced at or above this (store currency).

max_price.description: Only products priced at or below this (store currency).

in_stock.description: true = only products that can be ordered right now.

tools.name: update_cart
tools.description: Set the quantity of a cart line (0 removes it). Identify the line by product id and, when the product has options, the same options used to add it.

id.description: Product id of the cart line.

options.description: The variant choices of the line to change, if it has any.
